checkpoints.description: Task 'task-chronos-core-v1' completed successfully.
[1/4] Plan: abort time accounting, stats window semantics, collision-free atomic temp names, schema-tolerant history listing

impact_assessment.why: An independent review confirmed: aborted sessions archive elapsed_seconds=0 and lose focus time, the stats day-window counts sessions up to 7d23h old and crashes on naive timestamps, atomic temp names can collide within one millisecond, and history rows missing identifiers raise KeyError, bricking every command
impact_assessment.benefits: Focus totals survive an abort, stats include exactly the last N days and ignore future-dated rows, concurrent writes cannot share a scratch path, and one malformed history row can no longer disable the CLI
impact_assessment.risks: contract: stats window tightens to elapsed time, abort archives non-zero elapsed_seconds; dependency: none added (stdlib tempfile); concurrency: temp names become collision-free; state: on-disk JSON schema unchanged
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests for each behaviour change, full 'aikit check chronos' before the commit, backward-compatible defaults

checkpoints.description: [4/4] All fixes implemented and verified: 24/24 tests green, aikit check chronos 4/4 gates, ADR-002 recorded; checklists: passed

[1/4] Plan: second independent review; fix 4 crash-class defects (output encoding on redirected stdout, naive/garbage timestamp parsing, malformed model rows, invalid-UTF-8 state files) and 4 gaps (streak clipped by --days, abort not crediting bound tasks, unchecked --days/--duration/--estimate, non-idempotent task done)

impact_assessment.why: Reproduced defects: UnicodeEncodeError when stdout is a cp1252 pipe, TypeError/ValueError from _accumulate_active_segment on naive or garbage last_resumed_at, ValueError/AttributeError on malformed history rows, UnicodeDecodeError from uncaught invalid UTF-8; plus streak <= days_window, aborted focus time never credited to a bound task, and invalid integers silently accepted
impact_assessment.benefits: Every command survives malformed state and non-UTF-8 pipes on Windows; correct all-history streak; aborted work counted on bound tasks; usage errors exit 2 with a clear message; task done is idempotent
impact_assessment.risks: contract: invalid --days/--duration/--estimate now exit 2, otherwise CLI contract unchanged; dependency: none (stdlib only); concurrency: no locking added deliberately (single-user CLI, last-writer-wins documented); state: on-disk JSON schema unchanged, only reads become more tolerant
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests per defect before each fix; JSON schema frozen; storage writes stay atomic; re-run 24-test suite + aikit check chronos 4/4 before commit; ADR-003 records each change

checkpoints.description: [2/4] Failing-first regression tests (14 new; 24 -> 39 total) captured all 8 defects, then fixed: UTF-8 output reconfiguration, shared parse_iso in models (naive read as UTC, malformed contributes zero), tolerant from_dict coercion and interruption filtering, quarantine only on ValueError, all-history streak, abort task crediting, positive-int argument validation (exit 2), idempotent task done

Task 'task-chronos-review-fixes-v2' completed successfully.

[1/4] Plan: third adversarial review; harden session lifecycle idempotency, active-state type/state validation, task-binding and interruption validation, deterministic malformed-timestamp handling, and storage quarantine/durability

impact_assessment.why: Reproduced defects: finishing a stale COMPLETED active session double-credits its bound task; a valid-JSON non-object active file raises AttributeError; start --task silently accepts unknown task IDs; negative interruption durations are stored; malformed timestamps are excluded only by clock-ordering accident; task IDs can collide and overwrite an existing task; quarantine filenames collide within one second
impact_assessment.benefits: Lifecycle commands become idempotent and cannot double-count task time; corrupt active-state shapes degrade gracefully; typos in task binding fail loudly; invalid durations are rejected with usage exit 2; malformed history rows are skipped deterministically; task IDs cannot overwrite unrelated tasks; no quarantine data loss
impact_assessment.risks: contract: unknown --task and negative --duration now fail, stale completed active states are ignored; dependency: none added (stdlib only); concurrency: still last-writer-wins, no lock added; state: on-disk JSON schema unchanged
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first regression tests for every defect, then the minimal fix; full unittest suite and aikit check chronos 4/4 before delivery; ADR-004 records contract changes

[1/3] Plan: add a `history` command that lists archived sessions newest first with optional --days, --tag, --limit and --json, backed by a pure select_history helper and covered by failing-first unit and CLI tests

impact_assessment.why: Archived sessions are write-only today: finish/abort store them and stats aggregates them, but no command lists them, so a developer cannot review individual sessions, filter by tag or inspect notes; Repository.list_sessions already exists with no CLI consumer
impact_assessment.benefits: Users can review recent sessions newest first, narrow by elapsed window or tag, and integrate via JSON; the existing analytics filter semantics are reused so malformed rows stay skipped
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new command and options only, existing commands unchanged; dependency: none (stdlib only); concurrency: read-only, no new writes or locks; state: on-disk schema unchanged
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first unit tests for ordering/window/tag/limit/malformed rows and CLI tests for text/JSON/empty/invalid input; full aikit check chronos 4/4 before the commit; ADR-005 records the new command
